resolved_findings: ReleaseMutex and CloseHandle attempted independently for every acquired role.
Any release/close uncertainty records unresolved state, poisons owner and refuses restart/reuse.
Wait exceptions and non-acquisition statuses close the opened handle; close failure poisons owner.
Holder subprocess uses base Python executable, avoiding venv shim; readiness failure cleans direct owned subprocess.
verification_limits: Failure-return tests perform real native cleanup before returning injected failure; they prove fail-closed bookkeeping, not guaranteed repair of genuinely denied cleanup.
Independent callback probes create no native mutex and verify release/close attempts plus restart refusal.
Native tests use random generated fixture names only; no production mutex, task, application or file operation.
Supported qualification is cooperative same-session behavior. Observations do not prove future/adversarial cross-session exclusion.
